'''Joshua Loneau''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Milford tournament]] on 6 October 2001 with YMSYL, according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3040">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-09-madskills-at-milford-ma-9-6-01d3040/ madskills-at-milford-ma-9-6-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 9 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-09-madskills-at-milford-ma-9-6-01d3040/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
